provenance.quote:
OFFICIAL LEVY BALLOT
RENEWAL LEVY FOR FUNDS FOR CITY OF
GRAFTON STREET PAVING
General election to renew authorizing of
additional levies for the fiscal years beginning
July 1, 2027, July 1, 2028, July 1, 2029, and July
1, 2030, and for the purpose of providing street
paving according to the Order of the Grafton City
Council, entered the 4th day of August 2026.
The levy shall be on Class I property $2.16
cents; on Class II property $4.32 cents; and
Class IV property $8.64 cents per $100.00
valuation.
Instructions to Voters:
To vote in favor of the Amendment submitted,
darken the oval next to "For the levy". To vote
against the Amendment, darken the oval next to
"Against the levy".

measureRecords.whatItDoes: Renews Grafton’s additional property tax levy for street paving for the four fiscal years beginning July 1 in 2027, 2028, 2029, and 2030. The rates per $100 of valuation are 2.16 cents for Class I property, 4.32 cents for Class II property, and 8.64 cents for Class IV property.
measureRecords.yesMeans: Approve renewing the street-paving levy for those four fiscal years at those rates.
measureRecords.noMeans: Reject this proposed street-paving levy renewal.
